item.name: Roger
item.location: Roger's equipment shop in the starter village
item.relatedSystem: Wands, wizard hats, and wizard robes
item.whatTheyDo: Opens equipment shop menus for wand damage upgrades and HP gear.
item.playerUse: Visit Roger when saving Gold for a stronger wand, wizard hat, or robe.

item.name: Lombart
item.location: Starter village near the spawn leaderboard platform
item.whatTheyDo: Lets players sell unwanted materials from the material bag.
item.playerUse: Use Lombart when extra low-priority materials are taking up inventory slots.

item.name: Harryint
item.location: Right side of spawn beside the Wanted board
item.relatedSystem: Quests, Gold, materials, and Enchanted Stones
item.whatTheyDo: Offers quests, including early gold/material quests and a lava golem boss quest source for Enchanted Stones.
item.playerUse: Start here when you want repeatable quest rewards before relying only on enemy farming.

item.name: Fugitive Orc
item.location: Below a tree next to the Warhammer Dwarf on the forest route from spawn
item.relatedSystem: NPC quests, berry gathering, and forest routing
item.whatTheyDo: Gives an early side quest to feed him 10 berries.
item.playerUse: Bring berries while moving through the forest route if you want a simple beginner quest.

item.name: Lemin
item.location: Spawn platform near Lombart, Lemin, and the three leaderboards
item.relatedSystem: Leaderboards, Top Potions List, and spawn chest route
item.whatTheyDo: Acts as a named spawn landmark beside the leaderboard platform.
item.playerUse: Use Lemin and Lombart together to find the Top Potions List platform and sandy-island chest drop-off.

item.name: Optimistic Miner
item.location: Mine entrance near the boarded cave after the first Pickaxe Dwarfs
item.relatedSystem: Chests, mine route, and material farming
item.whatTheyDo: Explains that chests can give useful materials and marks the main mine entrance.
item.playerUse: Use the Optimistic Miner as the anchor for the miner cave, secret cave, and mine-top chest route.

item.name: Traveler
item.location: Camp with a tent, Cauldron, and bridge past Knife Goblins and Warhammer Dwarf
item.relatedSystem: Chest route, bridge route, Cauldron landmark, and lighthouse route
item.whatTheyDo: Marks the tent and Cauldron area used for chest, bridge, and lighthouse navigation.
item.playerUse: Use Traveler's camp to orient toward the tent chest, lighthouse path, and hidden platform routes.
